description: External bughunt suite for Python: real fix commits in two standard-library-only Python projects (packaging, tomli). No third-party source is stored here; benchmark/fetch_external.py clones the pinned commits, checks the package imports at both commits, and builds the gold sets locally. Each case is "lang": "python": hunts scan .py files with no test-module marker, and repros are unittest modules run from `import_root`.

cases.name: py-packaging-4d7875f
cases.summary: Parenthesized marker groups recursed without a depth limit, so a deeply nested marker raised RecursionError instead of InvalidMarker

cases.name: py-packaging-022ae6c
cases.summary: License-File validation accepted Windows drive-relative paths (C:LICENSE), which escape the project root when joined

cases.name: py-tomli-e1fdb94
cases.summary: A dotted key could have any number of parts, and a pathologically long one took quadratic time to parse

cases.name: py-packaging-2602dd0
cases.summary: The URL token matched any run of non-space, non-tab text, so a line break in a URL requirement was absorbed into the URL and later serialized as a second requirement line

cases.name: py-tomli-22834cf
cases.summary: An inline table silently kept the last of two duplicate keys instead of raising TOMLDecodeError

cases.name: py-packaging-0625596
cases.summary: The wheel build-tag regex was not anchored at the end, so a filename with a newline inside the build tag (foo-1.0-1\nabc-py3-none-any.whl) parsed as valid
